summary: A 50-foot pole L-4 tower in the Kootenai National Forest near Yaak, Montana, dated 1933 and gone by 1958.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com marks it gone in 1958; the page does not say how it went.

events.note: Marked gone in 1958 on firelookout.com; the cause is not stated

evidence.supports: about ten miles north of Yaak
FFLA coordinates 48.97894, -115.70148; FFLA status Tower Gone
listed under the Kootenai National Forest

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Firelookout.com gives one line ('1933: 50' pole L-4 tower. Gone 1958.') and the FFLA list gives status Tower Gone. The height is read from 50' as a pole height (15.2 m); the source does not say whether 50' is the pole height or the whole tower, so a human should check. Gone-by-1958 comes from firelookout.com only. No narrative history, photos, staffing or fire events found. The FFLOS Montana list I read did not show an entry for these three sites. Elevation 5544 ft is about 1689.9 m; not written to facts because the schema has no elevation key. Two web searches returned only the same pages. Record status 'gone' and kind 'tower' match the sources, so no corrections.
